settings.title: What do we do?
settings.text: At Metpure we focus on a variety of OEM water filtration systems, water filters, filtration faucets, components, and accessories. Also, we offer a wide array of plumbing products made for weekend DIYers, homeowners, plumbers, contractors, installers, and technicians. all at very competitive prices. With thousands of listing items (and growing), you will sure find something that you would need for your project.

settings.title: Our Products
settings.text: We carry a variety of innovative water filtration systems, filters, advanced filtration products under the Metpure Versatile brand, and diversified products such as RO system faucets, quick connect fittings, and tubings. Also we offer a wide variety of everyday plumbing products.

settings.title: Trusted Quality
settings.text:
Besides our innovative water treatment products, our systems and components
undergo stringent manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality control
so that nothing but the best are delivered to our customers. We secure many
products with third party certifications such as NSF, CSA, ASTM, ANSI, UL, and
UPC, so that our products are following the industry standard and beyond. Look
for many of our products shown with these certifications.

settings.title: Our Team
settings.text:
Our staff has earned accolades and acclaim for their tireless effort to
exceed every one of our clients’ expectations. Throughout the years, we have
demonstrated a high level of professional expertise in the water treatment and
plumbing industry. With this technical and qualified experience, we are
committed to supporting our customers not just with our products but with
excellent customer service and technical knowledge that we can offer to solve
our customers’ pain points and product technical needs.
